subject.title: Feature request: Support multiple accounts or instances of the same provider

question: Should this umbrella remain open to track convergence of provider-specific multi-account display, or be closed in favor of the focused simultaneous-display and account-management issues now that generic provider instances are explicitly out of scope?
rationale: The owner has rejected the proposed generic model but the broader user goal is only partially delivered across providers, so deciding the tracking structure requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep as the umbrella
options.body: Retain this issue as the cross-provider roadmap reference while provider-specific display work proceeds through narrower issues.

options.title: Consolidate into focused issues
options.body: Close this umbrella after documenting that https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1268 and https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/issues/1959 own the remaining user-facing work.

recommendation.title: Keep as the umbrella
recommendation.body: Retain this issue as the cross-provider roadmap reference while provider-specific display work proceeds through narrower issues.

likelyOwner.reason: The owner authored the current taxonomy and merged the first canonical implementation slice.
